protocol_scope: AERO4River planar applied-wrench trajectories replayed through the unconstrained Vehicle C coupled6 plant and projected to surge/sway/yaw.

acceptance.reason: The reference vessel and Vehicle C parameterizations differ; numerical agreement cannot validate Vehicle C coefficients.

comparison.claim: Applied-wrench surge/sway/yaw response through coupled6 only.

claim_limit: Supports execution of reference-neutral applied-wrench comparison through the actual unconstrained coupled6 plant. It does not validate Vehicle C dynamics, dual-water-azimuth propulsion, or full six-axis behavior.
limitations: AERO4River is a different 20.8 kg air-propelled vessel; its coefficients are not transferred to Vehicle C.
Only planar source channels are measured; out-of-plane states are stability diagnostics without reference targets.
Vehicle C uses bootstrap Capytaine geometry and empirical viscous damping.
